propositions: tests/unit/test_build_provenance.py rebuilds identical clean-source wheel and sdist artifacts separately across four tests, causing the module to run 35.93s instead of reusing immutable shared artifacts

wheel-from-sdist, sdist-content, and install-from-sdist tests can reuse a single session-scoped prerequisite wheel/sdist built once per pytest worker with REBAR_BUILD_COMMIT=abc1234 while preserving read-only access and distinct boundary coverage
install-from-sdist and empty-env-failure must retain their own function-scoped extraction or clean-tree build respectively to preserve distinct rebuild and failure-mode assertions

a deterministic build-call oracle must detect if the shared prerequisite artifact is rebuilt more than once per worker/session, and the provenance oracle must still reject missing or corrupt COMMIT values in shared artifacts
